description.value: A well-equipped private campground off the Trans-Canada between Donald and Golden, offering flush washrooms, laundry, playground, and mountain views — a solid highway stop within day-trip range of six national parks.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an RV and tent camping park in Donald, BC, offering RV sites, dry camping, motel rooms, and cabins. Showers are confirmed by the front page ('shower and laundry facilities') and the amenities page ('Washroom' section). Laundry is confirmed by a dedicated 'Laundry Room' section on the amenities page. Reservations are confirmed by the 'BOOK NOW' button and contact page language about booking availability. The OSM phone (+1-250-340-8482) differs significantly from the website's toll-free number (1-800-563-6122), and the street name spelling differs between OSM ('De Jordie') and the website ('Dejordie').
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-250-340-8482 but website shows toll-free 1-800-563-6122
Minor street name spelling discrepancy: OSM has 'De Jordie Road' while website consistently uses 'Dejordie Road'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor offering tent dry camping, showers, and laundry — a practical stop for touring cyclists traveling between Golden and Revelstoke.
